title: Compact on-chain evaluation result v1
description: Printed by the evaluator WASM to stdout as JCS bytes, returned by OutLayer to the tender contract's callback, validated and stored verbatim. Must be <= 900 bytes. Contains no bid content and no prices. rk is the full ranking: eligible bids by (total desc, price asc, index asc), then ineligible bids by index with total 0.

root.description: Bid-set Merkle root. Contract checks it equals the root it froze at close.

rubric.description: Contract checks it equals the stored rubric_hash.

bundle.description: sha256 of the public evidence bundle (JCS).

attempt.description: Contract checks it equals its own attempt counter.
